titanium_omega_lattice.description: At Layer 5 and above, individual fasteners connect into a LATTICE — a self-reinforcing web where each fastener strengthens all adjacent fasteners.
titanium_omega_lattice.security_property: Attacking any single truth at TITANIUM depth or above requires attacking the ENTIRE lattice simultaneously. One truth cannot be pulled without pulling all of them.
titanium_omega_lattice.current_lattice_density: 19+ enriched Bible chapters, each with 5-8 cross-references = 95-152 lattice connections
